name: @memebattle/build-conditions-swc
description: SWC wasm plugin of @memebattle/build-conditions: inlines condition branches and removes dead code at build time
author: Artem Zverev <themezv@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cargo build --locked --target wasm32-wasip1 --release && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/swc_plugin_build_conditions.wasm dist/
scripts.prepack: test -f dist/swc_plugin_build_conditions.wasm || { echo 'dist/ is missing: run pnpm run build first' >&2; exit 1; }
